<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The lines of a cart as a table or as cards: product, variant, price, quantity, line total and a remove button.
  Axes: layout (table, cards), media (image, none), density, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { CartLine, CartLabels } from "./cart-list.types";

export type CartListProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lines: CartLine[];
  empty?: string;
  labels: CartLabels;
  layout?: "table" | "cards";
  media?: "image" | "none";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import Card from "../compose/Card.vue";
import CardContent from "../compose/CardContent.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import CartTable from "../components/cart-table.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import NumberField from "../components/number-field.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lines,
  empty = "",
  labels,
  layout = "table",
  media = "image",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<CartListProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ remove: [id: string] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :tone="tone" :density="density" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <EmptyState v-if="((lines?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="shopping-cart" :title="empty" />
    <CartTable v-else-if="((layout as string) === 'table')"
      :field="tpl('{0}-qty', id)"
      :lines="lines"
      :labels="labels"
      :media="media"
      :density="density"
      @remove="(arg: string) => emit('remove', arg)"
    />
    <Stack v-else gap="4" align="stretch" data-slot="cart-cards">
      <Card v-for="line in lines" :key="line.id" variant="default">
        <CardContent class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
          <MediaFrame v-if="((media as string) === 'image')" :alt="line.name" ratio="1/1" class="size-16 shrink-0" />
          <Stack gap="0" class="min-w-40 flex-1">
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {{ line.name }}
            </Text>
            <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ line.variant }}
            </Text>
            <Text size="sm">
              {{ fmtMoney(line.price, line.currency) }}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
          <NumberField
            :value="(line.qty == null ? undefined : String(line.qty))"
            :name="tpl('{0}-qty-{1}', id, line.id)"
            min="1"
            :label="labels.qty"
            :decrease="labels.decrease"
            :increase="labels.increase"
          />
          <Text size="base" weight="bold">
            {{ fmtMoney((line.price * line.qty), line.currency) }}
          </Text>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            layout="icon"
            :aria-label="labels.remove"
            @click="() => emit('remove', line.id)"
          >
            <LucideIcon name="x" :size="16" />
          </Button>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </Stack>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
